egress.terms: "No Egress Charges" / "NO Charges for ingress/egress" — unmetered both ways, no per-request fees.

interface_detail: Any SSH tool: rsync, sftp, scp, borg, rclone, restic, git-annex; zfs send/recv on request
tooling: The canonical rclone/restic/borg/rsync target — every backend works because it is a real filesystem
chaining: SSHFS mount -> AList -> Cloudflare. No HTTP object API, so a wrapper is mandatory for serving
